admission: test-only; production supports() unchanged and closed
method: Unmodified full native rules package with admission overridden only for inventoried starter definitions. Normal setup, server entropy shuffles, legal commands selected by a seeded exploration policy, JSON round-trip before each command, no authored board or forced ending. Every stored 20-game transcript replayed from setup and matched the complete final state.

deckFormats.40: Test-only derivatives: preserve every unique definition, remove only duplicate copies. Not official/authored GEMP starter lists.

limitations: This is integration/replay evidence, not GEMP full-match parity or all-branch rules certification.
The exploration driver is a test policy, not production strategic CPU. It does not enumerate every reachable card function or timing combination.
Full traces and private game snapshots stay in the local output directory; committed receipts contain summaries and hashes only.
Existing failed-duel and deeper Chances guards remain. No guard is caught or skipped by the driver; any failure terminates the audit and writes exact pre-command state/attempt.
Broader modifiers, identity and card behavior, native service/authentication/concurrency and responsive full-match delivery remain required. Production admission stays closed.
